title: Signal Backstop + Rollback Decision Tree and Roadmap Dashboard
summary: Working sheet to align signal definitions, automated backstops, and a concise rollback decision tree for staggered rollouts (hosted + dedicated). Includes a compact roadmap dashboard and KPI thresholds for go/no-go and traffic scaling decisions.
objective: Make launch decisions reproducible under pressure: map observable -> threshold -> immediate backstop -> manual escalation, and tie those signals to roadmap phases and sprint owners.
decision_tree_ascii:
ROOT: traffic spike or error storm
|-- Is user-facing error rate > 3% for > 10m? --> YES -> Trigger automated traffic throttle (50%) and route to degraded model variant -> Check quality delta > 5%? --> YES -> Rollback to previous model version (30m window) -> Notify oncall & product ops
|                                                                                                                 --> NO  -> Continue throttle + investigate
|-- NO -> Is median p50 latency > 600ms for core generate endpoint? --> YES -> Scale dedicated pool by +20% (if capacity) else apply request queuing -> If latency persists 15m -> promote canary fallback model with lower compute
|-- NO -> Are KPIs for quality (precision@k, hallucination rate) degrading against baseline test set? --> YES -> Pause incremental traffic increase, open bug ticket, and run targeted evaluation set. If regression > threshold -> rollback

checklist:
Pre-rollout checklist:
- confirm telemetry: token-level cost, latency histograms, per-route failure reasons
- validate evals: golden prompts baseline and regression harness loaded in CI
- oncall roster set for first 72h and alerted channels ready
- canary model and fallback variants baked and tested
- traffic shaping rules and quota policies staged in infra config
- legal/CS notified for customer-facing changes
- run smoke script and collect baseline traces (save snapshot id)

Go/no-go quick checks (day-of):
- SLOs in dashboard green for last 24h
- capacity headroom >= planned peak +25%
- rollback artifact verified and bootstrap time < 30m
- feature flags ready to flip per region
